handbook-text:
An upgraded electric glider with six slots and 80,000 J storage (4x the original).

Normal flight uses the original Electrical Progressive glider controls. Press Space while airborne to deploy; hold Sneak (Shift) to boost. The Mk II is capped at 20 blocks/second, with powered thrust for sustained 60-degree climbs. Native glider movement is retained. Deployment arrests downward motion while preserving forward flight. Space deployment adds no upward launch; hold Sneak for powered climbing. For the first two seconds after deployment, downward speed is limited to 8 blocks/second with gradual downward acceleration. After that, dives can reach the 20 blocks/second total speed cap. Equipping it in a backpack slot prevents fall damage, even while folded or empty. EP banking, boost effects and cooldowns are retained.

Hold the Mk II vertical lift control (default V, rebindable) to rise at up to four blocks per second. WASD positioning follows normal upright walking directions. Lift keeps the glider folded. Release V, then press Space manually to glide.

At the default EP energy setting, level boost uses 450 J/second, climbing up to 600 J/second, and vertical lift 900 J/second. Lift replaces boost cost. Coasting uses no charge. Recharge using the standard EP charging station.

See the crafting grid under Created by for the ingredient layout and quantities. The schematic is required but not consumed. Crafting transfers existing charge from the 128V accumulator, capped at the new capacity. The new glider has six empty storage slots.
